title: Colosseum Arena Floor, Roman Forum and Palatine Hill
description: Exclusive priority access tickets allow you to skip the line and enter the Colosseum through the Gladiator’s Gate. Experience this historic landmark from a unique perspective on the arena floor, a restricted access area. Learn about the history and culture of ancient Rome from your guide as you explore this iconic amphitheater.

reviews.usertext:
I think this tour really would depend on your guide for success or not. Luckily we had Amanda who was absolutely awesome - funny, animated and with extensive knowledge of the colosseum and the forums. It was insanely hot and we were so grateful that she prioritized getting to shaded areas before she talked and disseminated information.

Tips:
1. 100% bring water bottles. There are free fountains to fill up, but sometimes the queues can be crazy.
2. Wouldn’t really recommend for little kids, a lot of walking and heavy history talk — also once you get into colosseum it’s very crowded.
3. Some areas you can’t be in the shade - sunblock up, bring hat/sunglasses
4. For some reason trip advisor tells you that the ticket you get isn’t the “real” ticket and you need to get the actual one there. It’s false info (we showed up really early and were told that wasn’t needed). Just show up 15 min before and they’ll check you in and randomly divide you into color coded groups.

The audio headsets worked great and were so so crucial so we could hear our guide clearly no matter how far she was, and to be able to ignore the crowds/other guides talking.
Would recommend this tour 100%, the 3 hours passed by quickly and was totally worth it.

Our 'small group' Tour was booked before we left the UK and was a smooth transition. The start time had to change (colosseum changed it) but we were kept informed and there were no issues.

Amanda was our guide on arrival and she was just great. So passionate and knowledgeable about the history of Rome and our small group were hooked on every word.
Amanda was keen to really immerse us in the old days and gave some amusing things to think about and when she was talking about a baddie - she put on a husky funny voice! It was a long tour but for sure well worth it. Comfy walking shoes needed but Amanda ensured we had places to stop to rest whilst she continued to delight us with her knowledge.

If you love Rome like we do this tour is a must and well worth the money and ask for Amanda is my recommendation. We event went to a local eatery where it was a reasonable price and lovely atmosphere and we asked her to join us as her day had finished.

Picked a few photos but there were hundreds !!

We took a guided tour in english with our outstanding guide Magda the best tour I have ever been on everything was very informative.

The tour took around 3 hours but was worth it getting to know the history of the Colosseum from a expert is something different than being there yourself and the extra costs are 100% worth it.

I would highly recommend people to take the tour you don’t need to stay in line and the history becomes more alive with a super guide the only thing which is important is to bring a water bottle in the warm high season.

There are places on the tour you can fill up your bottle for free inside and outside the Colosseum imagine to stand there where great Gladiators once fought.

Our tour guide was fantastic. She was articulate and knowledgeable. However, this was advertised as a small tour with a 15 person max. Our group had over 30 people. We were often fighting for views in already crowded spaces. It took a long time to get through ticket lines. Our guide had great illustrations in books that we eventually gave up on trying to see with such a large crowd. Really disappointing.

Our tour guide, Romina, was absolutely delightful. She walked us through the entire 3 hour experience and not only shared her vast knowledge of the sites, but made sure everyone was having a great time as well. Extra points for her ability to take pictures of everybody at the best spots.This was my families first time in Rome and this tour is definitely a favorite already. 10/10 would recommend to anybody looking to experience the colosseum and it’s surroundings.

Allessandro was our guide and she was amazing 👏. Not only was she tremendously informative she made the experience soooo much better by getting the group involved with her stories. Her passion for antiquities (professional archaeologist) was clear from the start and there was plenty of humour amongst all the learning. If you get her you won’t be disappointed.

The only bit this tour doesn’t include is the lower floor but I didn’t feel like I missed out on anything as you look down on this when walking around.

TIPS - although taking drinks is highly recommended for most of these walking tours you really need to be mindful of the lack of toilet facilities (the colosseum is an ancient building after all…). You get ONE chance during the tour on the way up palatine hill (just after colosseum bit) so plan accordingly.

We had a sunny October day and temperature was around 24c but if it’s raining there isn’t much cover (unlike Vatican tour when it does not matter so much about the weather). My advice if temperatures are anything around 20c plus would be to pack a disposable poncho or something similar as they don’t weigh much/small package unopened if not used.

Our tour guide did a poor job explaining history behind what we were seeing in logical order. It seemed like she was just spitting out facts with no relation to what we were seeing. She also heavily assumed we knew a lot of the history behind what we were seeing, which majority of the people on the tour did not. Additionally, the ear piece used was so bad that she kept cutting out and didn’t even care to address the issue despite people complaining.

The tour guide also didn’t seem to care about the people on the tour. She rushed through the tour, moving extremely fast through areas even though she knew we had quite of few older people in our group (70+ years old). Never did a head count, nothing. Just assumed everyone was there and kept going. At one point, she almost left behind an elderly British couple. Had it not been for other people in the tour telling her to wait, they would have been left behind.

Overall, this tour left a lot to be desired. The guide did a really poor job of getting people interested in what they were seeing, and clearly did not care at all about the fact people were not enjoying the tour. In fact, 50% or more of the people on the tour handed their equipment back and left the tour early. That alone should tell you all you need to know.

very informative trip round with our guide (Magda?). delivered information with a smile. lighthearted and passionate a great storyteller kept our attention as she is very knowledgeable. we had a few steps to climb and uneven roads to cross. in 26C sunshine the water fountains are useful bring a bottle.. we had time to listen and stop for photos . some great views. be careful finding start location bus 75 from Termini stops outside.

The Colosseum is a must see in Rome. We bought group tickets including access to the Arena floor, all with the skip-the-lines access with our group. Our tour guide Alessandra was a great story teller and had incredible audience participation skills. The tour was longer than expected as she said we were on "Italian time"; the details were great. We definitely learned a ton and had a great time.

Alessandra was such a great guide. She brought the ancient characters of Rome to life through her passionate story telling. By involving the kids and adults on the tour, making them the key characters in her tales, her love for Rome really shone! This three hour whistle stop, highlights tour is a must to see the best of the colosseum, Roman Forum and Palatine Hill. Would highly recommend.

The tour was overall pretty good - we enjoyed seeing the Colosseum, Palatine Hill and the Forum. However, we felt like our tour guide was so rushed we didn't really get a chance to independently soak in any of our surroundings and were constantly rushing to take pictures. She spent quite a bit of time doing re-enactments that didn't really add anything to the tour (and honestly detracted from it). Additionally, my partner studied Latin so he is familiar with Roman history, and often the information provided was inaccurate!

This tour is so highly recommended! Vasca was fabulous, and brought the ancient history to life. He navigated the queues and Covid requirements and the various areas of this tour artistically, keeping us enthralled throughout. Worth every cent

Lorenzo was our guide. I have been in other tours before but I have never seen a tour guide who was as knowledgable, passionate, hard working and honest as Lorenzo. He made history go live! Even the kids who were initially not interested, were later attracted to his talk about the gladiators.
The tour was great. It was hot but we survived with passing through water sources.

We knew that we were going in hoping to cover a lot of ground in one day with this tour and it didn't dissapoint at all. Our guide did a fantastic job of explaining everything and clearly had a lot of passion for the job that they were doing.

Every corner of Rome has incredible history and the guide used lots of pictures from a book to help us peak back into that history.

I would highly recommend this for anyone in Rome looking to experience all of these wonderful landmarks.

The guide also helped recommend us and get us a table at a nearby restaurant for the end of the tour.

The colosseum was great and the arena floor is a must in my opinion. Our tour guide was very knowledgeable and interesting and seeing the forum was superb. However, I was very disappointed that we didn’t even go to palatine hill, the start point of Rome and the home of many of the emperor’s palaces. We weren’t informed that we were going to be missing the hill because we were “running late” until I asked when we were going to it at the end of the tour? We arrived on time for our tour and the reason I booked this tour was to see it all, I could of booked with another company and actually got what I paid for. We couldn’t even go back and see the hill ourselves as our tickets had already been redeemed by the tour guide. Very disappointing and really tarnished the tour, we only had a limited time in Rome and didn’t get the opportunity to return ourselves. I’m also obliged to mention that our “skip the line” tour still had us standing around in various queues for about half an hour, although I imagine without being on a guided tour lines could easily be over an hour, so it’s not something that would stop me getting a guided tour.

Great tour, well planned and an excellent, knowledgeable guide (Scott) who made sure we were all comfortable in the 37 degree heat and scorching sun of a Roman August. I’ve visited Rome several times and am somewhat of a history buff but I learned a lot of new things about the city and the ancient Romans on this tour. My 12 yr old son and I thoroughly enjoyed out experience, we’ve booked another trip with the same company for an excursion to the catacombs and we’d recommend very highly.

We had a small guided group tour of 10 people. We went through the gladiator gate onto the arena, then to all levels. Amil was our guide and see was very knowledgeable and pleasant. She gave us many unique stories about the builders, Roman history and the back-stories of the Colosseum. Even some Russel Crowe trivia!! Ask for Amil’s group.

It was worth paying for the guide to see the Colosseum floor (you can only get to this part with a guide), but I’d try another group if possible. The tour itself was very phoned in. No storytelling and just a bunch of monotonous random facts that seemed to be pulled from the movie Gladiator. Our guide started off by telling us he wasn’t a teacher so we needed to ask questions (not what you want to hear if you love to learn), but then also proceeded to answer several questions with “it’s not important”. He didn’t seem to actually know anything outside of the script that he learned 10 years ago. He pointed out things like “these are bird cages” or “the girl with four horses” (You mean Nike aka Victoria??) Very little unique or interesting facts, sometimes hard to understand, way too much silence instead of storytelling, and lots of huffing and puffing into the microphone anytime we were walking. By the end we took our own ear pieces out and listened to other guides that were passing who were much more animated and interesting. It gets 3 stars because based off what we’ve heard this is a pretty average tour for of the colosseum, and it’s probably fine for most people if you don’t care that much and just want some pictures. If we ever come back we’ll definitely be paying the up charge for a good guide who actually cares.

Outstanding experience! Even though it was super hot, our tour guide kept us engaged and moving. She involved us in the stories to help bring characters to life. She was sensitive to others needs for shade, water, and time. She was very knowledgeable and engaging.

5🌟 Review amazing tour. We booked this tour for our first day in Rome with a 15&10 year old. Absolutely brilliant Radu our guide was so enthusiastic full of knowledge kept the tour fun (educational fun) he definitely made the tour for the kids so enjoyable brilliant guide

There’s so much to see and so many other tourists that you need a guided tour to get you round, beat the queues and guide you through two security checks. Our guide Humi was very knowledgeable and told us things in an easy going way whilst checking we were all together and safe.
Perhaps too long spent in the Coliseum rather than the Forum but this is just a personal view, you were free to stay longer in the Forum after the tour finished.
Humi told us about the viewing gallery at the top of the Vittoriana monument with great views over the Forum and the rest of Rome,which we wouldn’t have found without her.
Also there are great views and information on the road outside the Forum.
Go to the loo before, take water and comfortable shoes. Don’t linger too long taking photos or you can lose your tour.
Well worth the expense to experience it all.

Great time with Scott, our guide. Was incredibly hot that day, but he kept us moving from shade to shade, and pointing out all the water fountains on the way!

Funny guy, very informative about the forum, palatine hill, and then finally the colosseum (incl the underground, which gave another great perspective)….

Would highly recommend spending the extra $$ for the underground tour!

Humi was a great guide! She knew when to talk and when to stop. Her way of showing us the ancient sights really made us feel that we had travelled back to the past. Even my 11-year-old son found this trip very interesting!

While the tour was exactly as described and the tour guide was exceptional, the lack of responses to 2 separate requests for information on the best way to get to the tour start point from the train station is unacceptable. We were traveling with our daughter who is mobility limited and on 2 separate occasions I requested advise on the best way to get to their location. No response. Nothing. Very disappointing.

While the sites were impressive and an absolute must for visitors to Rome, the 5 stars are for our tour guide, Tatiana. She was not only informative but funny and somehow managed to keep our group of 10 straight, giving us nicknames to help her remember us. So many of these tours have guides who are knowledgeable but not laugh-out loud funny the way she was. She also managed to find us every inch of shade in the 95 degree heat on our walks.
She was a definite highlight of our time in Rome.

Tour was amazing… both interesting and informative. Our tour Guide Alessandra was the absolute best. She made the tour interactive, explaining everything in detail and really painted picture of how it was back then.

Vosco (sorry if I spelled it wrong) made it very fun with his knowledge of the palatine hill and colosseum. It made me want to learn more about the history. Don’t hesitate to book the tour. We enjoyed being able to go into the places without having to wait

We really enjoyed our tour of the Colosseum. We were only in Rome for a few days and we wanted to see as much as possible, so we opted to take the express tour of the Colosseum. It was perfect, not too long but also very informative so we really felt like we got all of the information. It was great to skip the line and the short wait through the security check wasn’t very long - it was nice that the guide kept giving the tour even in the security line. We spent a little extra time on our own after the tour was over, the guide suggested the viewpoint from the second level and it was beautiful. I would highly recommend Show Me Italy tours and, for anyone short on time, the Colosseum express tour is a winner!

Or guide Huma made our tour a great and immersive experience by her capable storytelling. She had excellent knowledge about Roman history and made it a great experience. The group was large but we were each given our own radio and earbuds to listen to Huma’s commentary so there was no issue with hearing her. A great experience all round.

Highly recommend this as a tour while in Rome - our guide Sylvia was amazing, so knowledgeable and passionate about the sites in Rome and definitely kept us engaged throughout the whole three hours. She was also very mindful of the heat and made sure to stop in many shaded areas to share stories etc. and also keep us well hydrated throughout the tour.

We have visited Rome several times before and was looking forward to this tour of the Colosseum/Roman Forum/Palatine Hill. Unfortunately for us it wasn’t worth the time or money. We knew immediately when the guide starting speaking (given ear piece that covers 1 ear) we could not understand him. His accent was so thick( expected but still heavy for an English guide) and the tour moved EXTREMELY fast thru the Forum. No time to take pictures or read signs, and couldn’t understand the guide. We understood about 50% of what was being said. He did a good job of answering people’s questions when we stopped. Next time we will get an audio guide as the areas are no,need and well organized.

I gave 3 stars at no fault of the company or tour guide. Scott was very knowledgable and did a great job guiding 25+ people in the extreme heat. For me personally it was just too hot and long (3 hours). If I did the tour again I would just choose the Colosseum part and skip the rest.

Wow! Didn’t think this would be as impressive as it was. We were very lucky to have a fantastic tour guide Julian (I think his name was). The tour itself started in the Roman forum where we were told stories of the early Roman settlements sat beside Caesar’s grave. From there we went up the Palestine hill before finishing in the Colosseum. The guilds was exceptional, not only did he make the experience come to life, he was also super knowledgeable and could answer any question that was thrown at him. Great show !

Vasco was a pro! Super tour, great insights, lots of wonderful photos taken & memories made. An absolute must do in Rome. Highly recommend doing Palatine Hill & Forum as it sets the scene and literally brings you back in time before the spectacle of the Colosseum 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟

Great tour led by Scott, an Italian American. Guide who’s knowledge was encyclopaedic. Loved the use of radio ear pieces - so you can wander and listen to Scott’s tour at the same time. Scott’s style was laid back and engaging - allowing us time to take that extra snap You need to be reasonably fit to do the tour as it is up and down hill and steps. Not forgetting it is usually over 30c most days during the summer.

We were a party of four and our total group was 17 which to be honest I thought was a little too large. However our guide, Rosa, was terrific. She was so knowledgeable and very personable and passionate about her home city which really brought the tour to life. If I was being picky I would say the Colosseum tour was probably a little too long but every taste needs to be catered for. I would highly recommend this tour it helped make our visit to Rome.

Truly a great tour! First of all, there was a marathon going on and even with that mess, we still got to enter and go around the Colosseo without any wait at all. Our tour guide Amanda was remarkable. She had a great way to explain the history of the monument in a very captivating way. She managed to get us to some great picture spots and walked us through the Forums in a super efficient way.

Our experience with, Show Me Italy, was very positive. We had an excellent tour guide, Amanda. She was informative and knowledgeable with a real passion for the history she shared. She was able to bring to life, with anecdotal stories, what it was like to live in Rome through history. She made it fun and interesting.

Do not use this company. We booked our tour 3 months in advance. One month out they asked for participants names. I did not respond for 48 hours as we are travelling from Australia to Europe which took over 30 hours due to transit stops etc. I replied within a few hours of us landing in Europe only to be told it was too late and we had lost our reservation. I told them we were on the air flying from Australia at the time their message was sent. They did offer us another day but this did not work with our travel plans. I do not understand why it was not a requirement to complete travel participant details at the time of making the reservation. One extremely unhappy customer!!

Our guide Allessandra was amazing. She brought the whole 4 hour trip to life ensuring everyone in our group was transported back in time. Allessandra engaged with each person in our group saved made sure we were ok in the 40 degree heat - shade was incorporated save lots of water too; Rome had freely available water/ fountains which was much needed! Even our teenagers enjoyed this excursion. We generally do trips like this in our own but so pleased we joined this arranged tour. We would book again.

What a fantastic company, we went to check-in but on arrival my wife became very unwell due to the heat, a lady called Susan was so supportive and rescheduled our trip for another date and time. THANK YOU Susan.
The tour guide was very informing and was constantly giving us information.
The company is called “Show Me Italy” and we can say for sure this team is 100%

The tour was organized from the start. Magda was a great guide and was very informative. Lots of good information and she kept us in the shade which was nice with 35C temp. I have been before without a tour guide and thought this was a great way to learn about the area and would recommend doing this for anyone.

What a wonderful experience! Magdalena was absolutely without question one of the best guides that I have had on similar trips. Her knowledge of the classics, the history, the politics involved and the people was second to none.

In my opinion this is well worth the money and you will not regret it. Magda went well beyond what was required of her to make sure we got the most from our experience and to make sure we didn't miss anything.

Thank you for helping to make this a fantastic unforgettable experience for us.

Rob

Definitely a must do tour in Rome, if you go ask for Amanda. Her energy and passion for ancient history is addictive, and she has an witty ability to relate ancient events to those happening in our world today. Amanda weaves stories into her tour in such a way that you will remember them for the rest of your life, instead of thinking ‘oh that’s a cool fact’ and forgetting it the minute you leave. Highly highly recommend.

Although most of the experiences we’ve done in Rome had been without a guide, we did not regret the guided colloseum and forum romanum tour one bit! Our guide was Fumi, who was clearly very passionate about her job and had a lot of knowledge about even the smallest details of the areas we visited. Even in the searing summer heat she managed to keep the attention of the group during the 2.5 tour. Big thanks to Fumi and the organisation - would definitely recommend!

I have always been passionate about the Roman empire and it's history. And on my first visit a couple of years ago I went on a guided tour in the Colosseo as well which was great but now I've learned even more than then. Our guide was very enthusiastic and made great references to here and now to show that not all that much has changed. Of course it was hot and that makes it a bitter harder sometimes but because she was telling with passion and humour, my sister and I hung on every word. Like I said earlier learned a lot of new facts as well and you see with different eyes with everything told that you would not see/get without the guided tour. If you love history or want to learn a bit more about the place, book the tour I'd say

We had such a nice time doing this tour! Our guide, Alessandra, was amazing! The way she told us about the monuments was really interactive and interesting. She also made sure we were in the shade and that we had the time to fill up our water bottles whenever we could. Would definitely recommend this tour!

Every part of the experience was superb. Our guide, Guiseppe, was an extremely knowledgeable historian who brought the past to life in minute detail. He explained how daily life, politics, religion and social attitudes intertwined, making everything easy to understand and appreciate. It is clearly something he is passionate about.
We moved at a good pace, starting at the Forum, then going up to the Palatine and along to the Colosseum.
We bypassed the queues (which were massive) and went straight into the Colosseum as a priority guided group. We worked our way around the site, Guiseppe imparting his extensive knowledge on everything from its clever design and construction, to the true nature of what went on within, shattering many a myth, but at the same time enlightening the audience. We finished at the far end of the Colosseum with Guiseppe's summary of the complex concepts of ancient Roman belief and practice - something that has clearly taken him many years to understand.
Everyone in the party of 30 was left in awe of the whole experience but understanding so much more than when they arrived a few hours before.

Our guide, Luca knew so much about all aspects of the colloseum, forum and palatine Hill. He was patient, kind and took time to answer questions.
Seeing the colloseum from the arena floor was quite moving, knowing what had gone on there- would recommend. As we were walking in 39° heat, Luca's offer to stop for regular bottle refills was also a welcome stop!

We very much enjoyed the coliseum and the explanation about the Roman forum. The history was spectacular. However, we were expecting a small group format and ended up with 37 people in our group. Also because 2 family failed to follow instructions and bring identification documents for their children, our guide wasted over 30 minutes of our tour time dealing with helping them locate ID documents for their children, rather than providing us a tour experience during that time :/

Tiziana was a fantastic tour guide. From the start of the day she had in depth knowledge of Rome and passion that was infectious. She was also very funny and made the tour feel very personable. Would recommend this tour and especially our guide!

Great tour, definitely worth the value. Our tour guide helped us maneuver crowds, took great photos, provided lots of information, and allowed us to have free time. Loved the tour and would definitely recommend it!

Excellent tour, our guide Magda was extremely knowledgeable and explained everything very clearly bringing it to life for us for that reason I loved the Roman Forum. My tip is just to make sure you wear sensible, comfortable shoes, although the Colosseum is very accessible and has a lift the Roman Forum and Palatine hill is more hard going. The tour ends inside the Colosseum so you have more time to look around (if you have the energy!). Would highly recommend this tour

Our guide Alexandra was ✨UH-MAZING✨! She was full of knowledge and energy (despite the 99F temps). She engaged the entire group and had us all smiling while learning. Her English was excellent and she speaks 4 other languages too! 5 Stars to the Office Elves — they were beyond kind to us despite my massive boo boo around location. 🙏🏼 I would highly recommend this particular guide and company to anyone embarking on a Rome tour.

This tour saved the day! We originally booked our Colosseum tour through a different company. Upon arriving in Rome they called and canceled the tour on us. This was at the top of our must-see list, so I quickly searched for a tour that would include it all. I found Show Me Italy through the "Get Your Guide" app and booked a tour that included all the levels of the arena, including the underground.

We hit the jackpot with Amanda as our tour guide! Her depth of knowledge in the ancient city truly brought the whole place to life for us. We could've listened to her talk all day.

Thank you so much for being the highlight of our honeymoon trip to Rome!

This is the second time we have visited Rome and done a colosseum tour. This one was not as good as the last.

The tour guide was okay, but did not give as much enthusiasm as our last guided tour.

He was knowledgeable in the history of the area and gave good insight into the history of the area. He gave us time to take photos and look around on our own.

From my recollection he did show some different areas of palentine hill that I never saw on the last tour which was interesting.

It was difficult to sometimes keep up with him as he never had anything that picked him out from the rest of the crowd.

I dropped a point because of the headset we were given. It seemed that several groups were on the same channel frequency so if he walked too far ahead, you ended up picking up someone else’s tour guide, which was of putting.

My husband and I booked this tour and because we overslept due to jet lag, we were late getting to our meeting point. A Show Me Italy rep called me to see if we were coming (we were on route) and they were able to catch us up with the group. We were so impressed with our guide “Roger”. He was very knowledgeable and tried hard to not overwhelm us with information but make sure he imparted the salient facts! He was very kind and patient. I would have given a 5/5 but because it was so busy at the forum and there were so many tours going on at once I got separated because he moved on too quickly before everyone could catch up. It took a while to find them!

It was a very warm day in the sun. Roger, our very knowledgeable guide tried to keep us in the shade whenever possible. Much appreciated. Roger kept us well informed on what we were seeing and did so in a very accessible way, and with humour. He knew his history, and we came away knowing and possibly retaining a little history ourselves. There were thirty of us from two to eighty and he managed to get us around and through all the other tour groups efficiently, losing no one! A very worthwhile tour with a company that was well organized . The heat was oppressive though. Best to take the tour early. We started at 10:20am and finished around 2pm. We were the eighty year olds. It became difficult in the Forum at the end of the tour.

We had a fantastic 3h guided tour with the most amazing guide Titziana. She is the best. She always remembered to include the entire group and make everyone feel welcome. Very knowledgeable and told us the history in a fun way with lots of humor. We learned a lot of history in a short time. Recommend

This was an amazing tour. Our guide George was really knowledgeable and friendly and gave us lots of insights into the Forum, the Colosseum, and the Roman way of life. It was quite a long tour in the heat so wear comfortable shoes and bring water! The head sets worked really well and the meeting point was easy to find. My only quibble would be that the tour is advertised as maximum 25 people but we had 31 on the day which made it slightly chaotic, but we still had a great time.

Our tour guide was very friendly and very knowledgeable. Was a great tour! It’s very hot without much cover so prepare and bring water. In my opinion the arena floor wasn’t worth the extra $$ you can see it all from the upper levels and not much difference in the view to be fair.

What a wonderful experience. Visiting without the crowds made this even better. Amanda was super knowledgeable and passionate yet was able to convey it all with a sense of humor! She was entertaining as well as considerate to all the different needs of her group!

This was such an amazing tour, we never usually opt for the tours and do it ourselves to save on the pennies but as there was so much history to this one we wanted to go for a tour. Tbh we picked this one as most of them had sold out, we hadn't picked this one fot any other reason than to not miss out. Were so glad we did our tour guide was Amanda and she MADE the tour! She was an incredible story teller and made us feel as though we were there 2000 years ago, she brought it to life, she was funny and captivating, it was so obvious how good she was as we could hear other tours going on next to us and they sounded a bit monotone and boring, this was by far the highlight of the whole trip! She also gave great tips on where to eat and drink for cheap as well as best places to go etc. Wish we had done it on day one. 100000% recommend this and get Amanda if you can!

Would highly recommend!! There’s so much to see and we’re so glad we chose to have an organized tour and I’m glad we went with Show Me Italy! Our tour guide, Amanda, was knowledgeable, funny, efficient, and helpful. She was even as accommodating as possible when it came to people showing up late and things like that. Great experience from start to finish.

I'll start with the positives: The tour guides knowledge of ancient Rome.
The negatives are this company states that its a maximum group of 15 people, not 34 like in our group. Also where is 1/3 of what I paid for? Palantine Hill was completely skipped and when I asked the guide I got a defensive response saying that the reason we skipped it is because our group was too big and unfit/incapable. What a joke!!! Now i get to pay again to go see what I've already paid for?
Look elsewhere as I don't reccomend.

It was really fun listening to Tiana telling us a detailed history of the place. Gladiators, Arena Fights etc., Music to my ear.😊 It was interesting. Its like i was watching the series SPARTACUS live😊 She was smiling the entire tour which we really like about her. She is approachable. A time well spent with my friends and a perfect tour guide. I highly recommend TIANA♥️✨ Thank you⚔️💚

Our tour guide Roger was excellent! He knew so much and did a great job explaining everything to us. We weren't rushing and there was plenty of time to take pictures as we went. He also put us in the shade before any long talks, which was nice as it was a hot, sunny day in early September. I didn't retain a ton of the information by the end as someone who wasn't super well-versed in Roman history to start, but I did still learn a lot.
The only issue we had was that there were so many other tours in the same areas that sometimes we overlapped radio channels with other guides, and ended up hearing the wrong guide for a minute. It was never for long though, and
I definitely recommend this tour.

The tour was excellent and the guide was extremely knowledgeable. It took a little longer than I expected to get started (the time was listed as 10am but we didn't really head out until around 1030, but I think this was due to late comers) but it also lasted longer than planned so our guide could get us through everything. The guide also helped us with taking pictures and was very amenable to questions. Really a great tour.

Sylvia was fabulous, informative and kept a great pace. The tour was so enjoyable from beginning to end. Lots and lots of walking. So exciting to be on the arena floor. I would recommend this specific tour and this tour company for future tours. Finding the tour office was a bit tricky and we would recommend better instruction/directions to find the office. The headsets worked great and we were informed every step of the way. You will be extra lucky if you get Sylvia as your tour guide!

Very knowledgeable guide made this an informative and enjoyable tour. Guide made recommendation of having water and to use the restroom as there was few oportunities during the tour and it would be crowded. She allowed time for everyone to do this and be ready. She changed the itenerary as we went to help avoid the crowds and this worked well. The use of audio headsets improved the experience for me as I have some hearing impairment and the group didn't have to crowd together to hear the guide. Would definitely recommend using this company.

Had wanted to see this area for years and so glad I decided to do so with ShowMeItaly. Magda was a wonderful guide, so much knowledge about the different layers of history all over Palatine Hill and the Forum and provided us with loads of recommendations of places to go for food and drinks on the rest of out trip. Half of our party was 30 mins late and despite waiting, she managed to fill the extra time with plenty more information and stories about Rome and it’s history. A must-do tour to get the best out of Rome’s most historic site!

Meeting point to confirm our tickets was chaotic with a large group congregating down a small side road and it took some time to get going due to “a website issue getting the tickets”. When we did get underway, entry to Colosseum was reasonably quick. We were in quite a large group, and the guide (Elena) did her best to keep us together and informed as it was very busy. Sometimes she did walk quite fast and it was difficult to keep up through the crowds, but despite this we overran and it was a long and tiring day doing all three sites in one go. Elena was informative and tried to keep us all engaged throughout.

I did this tour yesterday with Alessandra, it was a great tour and very informative. We were well looked after throughout the tour and it was made memorable by the enthusiasm the tour guide had for the history of the area. I would 100% recommend this company to anyone and would use again in future for a different tour.

I loved this experience. Our group was larger (25 people) but our guide made it feel small. The arena floor was really cool - and there was so much great information provided. It is long- but definitely worth it.

Our guide, Lorenzo, was fun and knowledgeable. We really got our money’s worth! Especially during the Roman Forum part of the tour. We fell like we had a beautifully afternoon and learned a TON!! We would absolutely recommend this tour, but the walk and steps may be difficult for those not in decent shape.

The guide Silvia gets 10 stars ! 🤩🤩🤩🤩🤩 she was fabulous. Really passionate & informative. The trip was well organised. She coped well even with a family of latecomers. The headset system works really well ( that seemed to be a theme with all the companies ) Wish we could have had her for our other trips in Rome ( used a different company for those ) You really need a guide to understand what you are seeing & to make it come alive. Thank you Silvia ! The only thing I would change is the size of the group which was very large which is why I only gave 4 stars

Nariman the guide was informative and took time to explain and answer questions. She is experienced at moving around the Colosseum and the three hours with her were well spent and interesting.
The place was packed and that will always take away from the enjoyment of any tour.
What I was not impressed with was the large group of 30!!! Too big to follow group and keep up, and not expected at this price from tour operator. Guide did well under the circumstances.

I loved, loved, loved this tour. We had an easy meeting point and were given some background historical info before we set off. When the colosseum came into view it was breathtaking, and we were given time to take pics. The guide was super knowledgeable and gave us facts about what we were looking at all the way along. We were given the chance for bathroom breaks, and to fill waterbottles along the way. The guide answered all of the questions from the group and was truly exception. Cannot praise this enough, would highly recommend.

We had the best tour of the Colosseum, Palatine Hill and Forum with our guide Sylvia leading the way. From start to finish, we looked at ancient ruins, but visualized life in Rome beginning in 80 AD and the centuries to follow. Sylvia’s stories describing how the Colosseum was built, the spectacular performances and the “backstage” efforts were fascinating and her visual aids showing then and now pictures were excellent. Leaving the Colosseum we travelled up the Palatine hill as our guide explained the different layers of Rome and then led us to the Forum area telling stories of Julius Caesar, Augustine and Constantine as we walked. Great tour. I would love to do it again someday.

Our tour guide was Magda and she was absolutely wonderful!
She was very knowledgeable of the sites, and the history of the sites.
The site was very busy when we visited and she did a great job of keeping the group together.
Finally, when it was time to leave, she offered to guide us out of the site and we were able to gain extra knowledge and history.

This activity was absolutely amazing mainly due to our wonderful guide Humi. She was so informative, passionate, and engaging. She took us back in time as we visited each site and brought it to life.
Going to the Arena floor is definitely worth it.
Humi made sure that during our guided tour she would stop for us to take photos at the Best spots. As there was a heatwave, she also made sure she would find shaded areas for us as she explained the history of the sites.
I would highly recommend this activity, and if you are able to, request Humi!!

This was an amazing tour that truly floored me. We got to go down on the bottom level of the Colosseum. Roger did a great job keeping us all together and accommodating some members of our group who got very hot and tired because it was freaking hot. On the day we went it felt like it was burning with the fire of a thousand suns, but it was still great to see.

Barbra was a great tour guide, so much information and really looked out for everyone in our group, especially the people managing with a young baby. Full of interesting information delivered in a friendly, informative manner. Choose great photo spots and was ready to help take family snaps - highly recommend.

If you are coming to visit the ‘Coliseum’ and the Roman Ruins book this tour! Easy to find and start from. Humi my guide was genuinely amazing, her incredible depth of knowledge and way she involved us in the experience was phenomenal! Giving us the real facts, stories behind each section and dispelling the myths. I cannot praise this tour highly enough. I’m going to have to come back and do it again - so much information to take in but also so very thoughtful, finding us fountains to refill our water and the perfect shady spots to relieve us from the heat and take a photograph. I even ended up a free man at 30! #winning #blownaway Grazie Mille!

Thoroughly enjoyed every part of this tour with Scott.
He is very informative & so humorous. The tour was guided in a relaxing way with time to sit down, soak up the amazing history & atmosphere.
We were told the wrong meeting place & another guide came & found us & made sure we went to the right meeting point. No stress.
Everyone was so friendly, answered all our questions, were very interactive & so kind.
Thank you Show Me Italy & Scott.
One hundred percent recommend.

Humi was a wonderful guide. She made the experience of Roman history concrete. I loved being inside the Colosseum, climbing up the steps, being on the arena. Although, my favorite part of the tour was when Humi told various stories about Nero.

This tour covered a lot of great sites but was difficult to follow. We did a 3:15 tour and it was very hot, our tourguide did not prioritize finding shade as he delivered the information. The information was difficult to follow, it was not in chronological order, did not connect, and wasn’t fun to learn about. I am very interested in Roman history but my guide did not make the information exciting or comprehensible. The Roman forum was pretty cool, we all wish our coliseum experience was better. They also do not leave any time to look into the gift shop.

A visit to Rome would not be complete without a visit to the Colosseum.

We booked a tour last minute and met our guide Scott at the arranged meeting point which was very close to the Colosseum. We were each handed a radio and ear piece so we could clearly hear throughout.

The tour started at the Roman Forum and Palatine Hill and entry to the area was straightforward and quick. Although not as well known as the Colosseum, a visit is well worth the time.

We then entered the Colosseum at the required entry time, which was also quick and straightforward. The Colosseum is as spectacular as expected and fascinating to see how it was built.

Scott was a superb guide and kept us informed and entertained throughout. He did his best to find shady spots through the tour and allowed time for photos and toilet breaks.

Great tour and we’ll worth it.

This was probably the most excited my husband has ever been to do a tour. Being that Gladiator is one of his favorite movies. This was really an incredible experience walking through the colosseum and being on the arena floor. You just feel so small in that huge arena. It’s very eye opening. Our guide was very patient and walked through the history of everything and showed us things we wouldn’t know to look at. We highly recommend this tour. Such a great day!

It was great that we were fetched from the ticket office and taken straight to the Colosseum. Nicola, our guide, was very knowledgeable, informative and easy to understand. There were so many people there.. I wouldn’t recommend it for people with walking difficulties or with small children. All in all an enjoyable tour

Really interesting and informative tour. The guide was very knowledgeable and definitely brought the whole trip to life for us. He threw in a bit of wit and humour as well, which kept us all entertained .He put into context almost 3000 years of history,which would have been difficult for us without a guide.
The meeting point was easy to find.Even though we were part of a group of 25, we still felt we were enjoying the sights together.
The guide had a book which he showed us pictures from.I think it would have brought it more to life if we were given an information book for the tour.Sometimes it was hard to visualise what was being referred to.

There was quite a lot of waiting around for the tour to start and I’m not sure 20 people constitutes a small group but the tour itself was fine. Our guide Magda was knowledgeable and enthusiastic. I thought we were supposed to have a visit to the restricted area of the arena but that didn’t happen, I’m not sure why but otherwise it was perfectly good

Excellent and great value for money. This exceeded expectations. Our guide, Lorenzo, was a great font of knowledge giving insight to all 3 attractions. He made sure everyone was together and moved on at a good pace as 3 hours may seem a long time but you could easily spend 3 hours just in the forum! Key aspects of the history and monuments were covered. Thoroughly recommended.

Tour was great and worth the money even it's just to skip the lines to get into these places. I would have done the path a little differently on my own but I think the guide had it down so that the way up wasn't as brutal as the path I would have taken. The information was good but not a historical deep dive if that's what you're after.

Shade was hard to find but we stopped at least 8 times for a break as the sun was pounding.

We did the Colosseum tour and the guide parted giving us enough time to explore the site on our own.

We had a wonderful time visiting the colosseum, the forum romanum and the Palatine hill. Our amazing guide Claudi did a fantastic job telling us all about the sights and showing us a lot of cool spots: we booked a German tour and there were 12 of us - a perfect group size. All the admissions to the different spots were already organized and we didn’t have to stand in line! It was an amazing experience, we learned a lot and had a really good time! Highly recommend to anyone looking to visit the Colosseum!

Scott (your guide) was very knowledgable and funny. Even if your not a massive history buff, he made the tour very relatable and took time to make sure everyone had water and shade. Definitely worth the price and experience.

Don’t forget to tip!

We toured on a hot, busy day in July. Our guide was Luka. He was knowledgeable, but his English wasn't the best so the tour was not as good as it could have been. He did a good job of keeping us together and finding the shade and he was able to answer our questions.

Nefarious organization: although the group was on time, we left 40min late. Before leaving, we must return the radios for listening to the guide because they did not work, so we did the tour without radios. This meant a break every time there was an explanation, which, in addition to the sit-in, then we had to run to see what they had explained to us (little and badly), because the attractions were going to be closed. The truth is that the comments in the group were totally displeased. All of this, paying €47 per person!!

We did this tour yesterday with the underground of the colosseum as well. Our tour guide Lorenzo was very very informative of all areas. Although earmarked 3hours for the tour our lasted over 4.5hours which meant we were slightly against time for the football in evening. So just allow more time than advertised. Bit well worth the money

George was the best tour guide for our walking tour of the coliseum, the Roman forum, and the ruins in the hill. Just a fair warning, it is a long walking tour, so if walking is not your thing I suggest you don’t book this tour. I loved the walk even with the heat, our tour guide made sure we stopped to refill our water bottles, and showed us the important artifacts and locations of these ancient ruins. I highly suggest booking this tour!

Really worth it, highly recommended. It was super fun and I’m so glad that I chose this tour. Lorenzo, our tour guide, he was super passionate and knowledgeable about the Roman history, he gave us tons of information about the architecture as well. Please note that there were no break between, please get food and drink and use bathroom ahead of time!

My partner and I loved this tour! The guide was very knowledgeable and gave plenty time for questions. There was so much to see and do but the guide did a great job of summarising some of the 'best bits'. Easy to find pick up point and ran to time.

Great tour and I like how we spent more than an hour in the coliseum. You can really feel a lot of the history. It is sometimes difficult to hear the tour guide even with the earpieces, but our tour guide was very knowledgeable and polite.

This tour was amazing and I would insit you do this if you are going to Rome! Our guide was so informative with a nice touch of humor. She also took GREAT care to find us shady spots to stand when she told us about a place and making sure no one got left behind. Also, getting to see more of the Colosseum because of being on a group tour is 10000% worth it. I would do this tour again.

Amazing and informative tour provided by Alessandra. She made the tour really fun and enjoyable. Not only were we able to see the incredible sites, but we were also provided with key historical facts and details to bring the tour to life. 100% would recommend.

All I can say is wow! What an amazing tour and what an amazing tour guide. Giulio was our guide and you could really tell how much he loved all the history and historic sites he was telling us about. Incredibly knowledgeable and also super engaging and funny. This was one of the best experiences on our trip to Paris and Italy. Even the two teenage boys were impressed and engaged. Do not miss this experience, so worth it!

A wonderful tour of ancient Rome. My group of 18 (multilingual) had a great tour with Francisco (in English) providing the history and events of the Colosseum Arena Floor, Forum, and Palatine hill. Keep in mind this is a Walking tour, and although the distances aren't great, the Colosseum has many stairs, as does Palatine Hill, and the cobbled paths can be slick, so watch your footing. Comfortable shoes are a must!

Such a great tour. It was amazing to lay my eyes on such historic sights. Our Tour Guide was himself genuinely interested in the subject matter, and cared very much that we all understood the information, as well as where we were standing at any given moment. He also had a good sense of humor, which kept things fun and interesting. I don’t remember his name, but he has a bald head. 5 stars for him. I would definitely recommend this tour.

We had a fabulous tour guide called Vasco. He was extremely knowledgeable, clear and comical. I’d done a tour of the Vatican the day before that was really quite tedious thanks to our tour guide so Vasco was a breath of fresh air.

Loved looking round the coliseum and learning new things about it. Would highly recommend this trip.

I would not recommend this experience. The groups are very large. The tour guide was not engaging, and did not share any information that you would not be able to find online. One plus is that you are able to skip the line at both the colosseum and Roman forum

This was one of the highlights of our trip to Rome for a weekend booked online very simple process and easy to find meeting point.
When we got there was given stickers and headsets and told what we were doing and in which order they saved the best for last the collesuem was amazing. The roman forum Lorenzo our tour guide showed us lots of great stuff pallantine hill was impressive and the view front the top breath taking.
The collesuem was something else took our breath away walking in the footsteps of the bravest people to have walked the earth the Gladiators.
Would thoroughly recommend this tour to anyone.

The best tour thanks to our tour guide, Dario. He is incredibly knowledgeable and passionate about history. Additionally Dario is a great storyteller and funny so it was almost like being in the scenes of history. Big difference against anyone else.

Note: Rome has a lot of steps and this is not the exception, we were able to go with a light stroller everywhere but you need to carry it a few times.

Really great guide called Scott, nice relaxed style looked after us making sure we got water and access to rest rooms during tour. He had a book about the colosseum to give us pictorial explanations of what he was telling us which was very useful. The colosseum, palatine hill and forum took 3 hours but flew by very enjoyable and fascinating. We were slightly late due to our transport arrangements but the staff were great quickly checking us in and walking us to meet Scott and the group. Good team great tour thank you

Easy booking. Excellent information on where to meet. Our guide asked us to call him daddy’. 😂 He was very informative, had great stories and was very entertaining ( not to mention easy on the eyes— think about it). We enjoyed it so much and would encourage anyone to book this trip.
One of the best tours I have done. Our Guide was extremely knowledgeable and pointed out so many bits that we would have missed without him. Can't recommend enough great guy and a great tour

This tour was rich in information about the three sights we visited. Our tour guide, Giulio, is an archeologist and provided many interesting facts and stories that helped ancient Rome come to life. He was also very personable. His reconstruction photos also helped us understand the areas better.
We had basically no line to get into the Colosseum, which was great! And it was cool to walk the arena area as well as the upper level. The areas are amazing to examine in and of themselves, but going on this tour, we got so much more out of the experience than if we had gone by ourselves.

Vasco was a great tour guide, very informative and showed great interest in the group. He told us everything we needed to know and made sure no details were left behind, definately made our visit better.
Highly recommend.

What a fantastic experience - we loved every minute of it!
This was entirely down to our marvellous guide Giulio who expertly steered us through not only the amazing monuments, but centuries of Roman history too.. With his extremely detailed and impressive knowledge, evident passion and enthusiasm for the subject and really fascinating stories he literally brought the past to life for us.
Thank you so much for a truly memorable and exciting day!

Marcius was a great guide. We got to see the typical sites but we also got a lot of perspective. Our guide was passionate and energetic but also attentive to the dynamics of the group. Wear comfortable shoes because there is a lot of walking but I would definitely do the guided tour.

Our guide Humi was fantastic. She was so knowledgeable and made the tour really interesting. The forum was amazing and her explanation of the ruins and what was happening during the ancient Roman Empire period made it all come to life. The colosseum was incredible. Overall an awesome day out.

If someone is looking for awesome experience trust these guys. Our tour guid was so enthusiastic and energetic that in 30d degrees you even didnt feel tired. This was our first time and absolutely loved it.

Scott was an awesome tour guide! Great commentary the entire time and very considerate and helpful of everyone in the group. Would highly recommend this tour and if you get Scott as the guide even better! Bring a hat and water bottle as it gets hot in the warmer weather but Scott was really considerate of this and made sure we were all comfortable. Thank you!

Scott was our guide for the forum, palatine hill and the colliseum. He was informative and entertaining. The use of a mic and radio earpieces meant it was easy to hear everything even in our group of 20.
The only reason I am not giving 5 stars is due to how crowded the sites themselves were which is obviously not the fault of the tour company

Coloseum. Roman Forum and Palastine Hill is what I payed for. What I didn't get was the Palastine Hill . Disappointing. No apologies ot anything. Just tried to go by it but when questioned. Replied no time. Why is that. Because everything she told us about something she had to stop and teach and ramble... She is a teacher in her work world but we are adults on a time tour apparently. Should have walked and talked. Better time management. Plus we lost 20 minutes because headsets were not working. This should have been checked before tour started...

Loads of information was presented. Lorenzo knew his stuff. However I felt we could of spent less time in Colosseum and learnt more about the other aspects of Roman history. It felt like it was dragging on some bit. But overall Lorenzo was enthusiastic and attentive.

I feel you could easily complete the tour in 2 hours.

Guide was very knowledgeable and shared a lot of history and interesting facts. Due to the heat it would have been nice to find shaded spots to stand in. The group was quite large (around 30 or so) which made the experience less intimate. Having headphones was very useful due to the large group and the huge crowds. If you can wake up early and take a morning tour to beat the heat and the crowds I would suggest that. Overall was a good tour and I would recommend it.

Amanda was our tour guide and she was the best!!! She was so knowledgeable and managed to provide us with a ton of information without it coming off like a lecture but instead a fascinating and upbeat adventure. We covered so much ground and she was so fun and informative each step of the way. She went above and beyond with any questions asked and at the end even took the time to give us a bunch of great recommendations for what else to see (and eat!) in the area. This was our last day of our trip and I’m glad this was how we ended. Would definitely recommend!

A really nice guide gave ays a great experience if all 3 venues and was very passionate about her duties, despite having done the tour over many years. 😀 she took us to great places with fascinating stories and provided us with right amount of shade and rest. Good job and thank you.

Our guide, Lorenzo, was very knowledgable and gave us all the information about the ancient Roman temples in the forum and taking us up palatine hill. Lots of facts that would have just passed us by if we had walked alone. The tour of the Colosseum was amazing, getting a gladiators eye view of this impressive arena and a look at where the wild animals would have been kept.

What a fabulous experience, the tour guide was amazing, so informative, funny and very interactive.
The experience of booking, going to the meeting point was so easy, lots of email communication too.
Would thoroughly recommend.
Used Trip Advisor for a Vatican Tour too.
Didn't have to pay until a couple of days before the visit although booked it 6 months in advance so really loved that flexibility.

Tour of the colosseum was excellent , lorenzo our guide was very knowledgeable, but it took forever to get into the colosseum as there were to many in our party . We stood around for 30 mins just waiting for things to get sorted . Other group members were becoming annoyed.

I have never booed a city tour online and was quite nervous about doing so but I have to say now that I’ve done it I would definitely do it in the future. Scott was our tour guide and he was brilliant. Extremely knowledgeable and friendly. We were given a great insight into the colosseum and Palatine Hill. Very well organised.

Our guide Amanda was very entertaining,she told the history of ancient Rome with lots of humour, knowledge and spectacular stories. The sun was burning, but she tried to look for shade all the time 😎. The tour lasted for two hours, in my experience it was like 5 minutes. Time flies when you're having fun 😃. Thank you Amanda!

We had such a great tour! Amanda was our tour guide and she was a perfect balance of informative and hilarious. The majority of the tour was focused in the colosseum which suited us. There are regular water stops and Amanda always tried to find places for us to congregate in the shade. It was extremely hot so we didn't go up the top of palatine hill during the tour but we didn't feel like we'd missed anything. We felt like we learnt a lot without it being an information overload.

Easy to find meeting point. Tour guide spoke fantastic English, and provided far more information than we would’ve otherwise had available. Tour took 3.5 hours, did not feel rushed at all, plenty of time to look at things and could remain in the Colosseum afterwards if you chose to. Would highly recommend, well worth the money!

Throughly enjoyed our experience of the Colosseum, Roman Forum & Palatine Hill with our wonderful guide Lorenzo on 13th Feb. Lorenzo's knowledge and enthusiasm for the history was evident from the very first moment and we were very pleased to have him as our guide. The tour of the Colosseum was fascinating and just being there felt quite emotional for me. Highly recommend this company and very happy with the whole experience. Thank You Lorenzo!

There was nothing about taking ID for under 18s. Very stressful start and couldn’t listen to first 30 mins as scrambled for copy of ID from family and friends back home. 40 people; too much. guide difficult to follow at times.

Having always loved my history,this was my ideal way to spend time in Rome. The guide was very informative. The only problem was, I need a stick to walk and the guide didn't stop to check that I was able to keep up. I missed a lot of the information because I had fallen a little behind and kept losing transmission! I appreciate there are time constraints, and it is a walking trip, but I just felt that he went charging off a bit. That being said, we really enjoyed the trip and learnt a lot. I would definitely recommend

It was a very informative tour. Booked it at the last minute and so glad that I did. It was a very hot day, but our tour guide, Rosa, was wonderful. She made sure we got shade and rest breaks. Helped us to even fill out water bottles. She took very good care of another guest who was having trouble with the walk and the heat. Be prepared to walk and it does take 3 hours, but was overall great. Would recommend

We did the colosseum and surrounding sights tour. Skipping the lines and being able to start seeing the history of these amazing places right away was terrific. Our guide was super knowledgeable and very courteous. He gave us plenty of time to explore and take pictures on our own, water breaks, and time to use the rest room if needed. It really was more than what we could’ve imagined.

We completed the Ancient Rome and colosseum tour with tour guide Lorenzo and it was absolutely fantastic. Lorenzo is a wealth of knowledge and really took the time to share with you this information about each area we visited on the tour. I would recommend this tour and company to anyone visiting Rome!! Thank you Lorenzo

Very nice and interesting tour around the Colosseum and Roma Forum. Amanda was our guide and she was really knowledgable en very enthusiastic. I went with my two boys (10 and just 12) and they only had some ENG in elementary school, but they were taken by Amanda's enthusiasm and she also was very clear. They understood well. Thanks Amanda, it was 3 hours in the heat, but we enjoyed every bit of it!!

So stoked we did this experience on a tour and not just wandering around by ourselves. Our guide Scott was awesome and we learnt so much- plus the pacing felt like we were of getting enough spot.
Just do it, seriously worth it.

The Colosseum portion was fun and exciting but crowded to the brim. Tour groups are constantly mushed together. The only time we had space to ourselves was when we went to the Colosseum floor.

Palatine Hill was nice except all the stairs to the top. Get in shape for this tour. We easily did 12,000 steps from this tour alone.

We had Barbara and she was nice and helpful.

The guide was brilliant full of information and really helpful. Very friendly Georgio and answered all questions. The tour took us from the office to the colluseum and into the main arena. This was amazing and such a sight. We went up into the first floor and saw the antiquities. I'd say that you don't have time to look in the museum or the cases as it's all rushed. You then leave the colluseum and go to Roman forum and Palatine hill. This is a trek. Everyone of us were tired by this time and you have to climb the hill to the top. It is worth it for the view.

Don’t hesitate to book this tour! It was so fun and very informative, I learned so many things about the colosseum. Our guide Giulio was AMAZING. He was passionate about Ancient Rome which made it much more fun. 100% satisfied. Will do it again and hopefully we’d get Giulio again!

Our tour guide (I think his name was Giovanni) was incredible. He knew the history so well and kept the 3 hour long tour interesting the whole time. If we had walked around without his guidance, we would not have learned so much about the Colosseum and the rest of the area. I would highly recommend this tour!

It was a great start of the morning when we met a guy promoting the tour, and he brought us to their office, where they offer great other tours. Overall, the experience was great. Our tour guide Fumi explained everything in perfect detail and did not leave out anything worth mentioning. Her english and the way she spoke was full of finesse and poise. Everything she mentioned was totally understandable.
At the end of the tour, she even answered questions about the history in Rome.
I totally recommend the tour and the guide as well.

We had an amazing tour guide called Emiliano, who was really friendly and so knowledgable. It was a three hour tour and I was engaged the entire time and Emiliano had so many interesting stories to tell.

We had a brilliant tour of the colosseum and then Palentine Hill and the Forum were so beautiful. Emiliano gave us time to enjoy areas and also to take photos.

Every question we had he was able to answer! Would highly recommend!

Magda was a fantastic guide. She give us lots of information in a very animated way. Her descriptions enabled us to “see” much more than the remains of an ancient civilisation .. but also a way of life. The whole trip was well guided, moved at a good pace and was totally fascinating,

I am super glad that we booked this tour. The tour organizer was absolutely amazing. She went above and beyond so we didn’t miss out entry. We were late to our meeting point due to circumstances beyond our control and she guided us via message updates and calls to our group. The tour guide was super knowledgeable and entertaining. We learnt a lot of intriguing facts about the colosseum and life during Roman time.
I highly recommend Show me Italy!!!

An unmissable experience in Rome. It was particularly cool to be able to stand on the Colosseum floor. Our guide was very knowledgeable and paced the tour really well. We were given ample time to take photos and really enjoy our surroundings. Overall, a really good experience!

Brilliant tour - very informative, relaxing and enjoyable experience. Meeting point was easy to find and although there was a lot of walking there was so much to see and learn about that we didn’t notice. Barbara was our tour guide and she was very knowledgable and friendly. She was very careful to make sure the group stayed together in the busy Colosseum. We had lots of time to take pictures and ask questions. We had a fantastic time experiencing this beautiful place. Thank you!

Wonderful tour! It was the perfect length with enough time to enjoy the sites. Our tour guide, Humi, was very knowledgeable and clearly loves her job. We appreciated her attention to detail and the pace of her tour.

Truly all encompassing tour of the Roman forum and Flavian amphitheater(colosseum). Our guide Lorenzo was not only very informative but also very personable. The best tour ever. Our guide Alessandra was wonderful, fun, and extremely knowledgeable. She is truly in love with Rome, and you will be, too, by the time you see the Colosseum, the Palatine Hill, and of course the Forum. Thanks so much, dear lady!!!!

I have always been a little wary of "skip the queue" tours - (I know it is "skip the line" but "line" really - is that even a thing?) On a short visit to Rome, with five children and a biblical crowd scene at the Colosseum we were talked into it by a person with an "official" blue bib. He told us that the next tour would leave in five minutes and would have twelve people on it. In Roman style - the wait was 20 minutes and the crowd had swollen to over 30 by the time we got started but, wait....

Our first guide was Jana. I was sceptical at this stage given the expanded group and delayed start. But Jana had a real in-depth of knowledge about the Flavian amphitheatre (see, not a colosseum) and put it across in a professional (even professorial) way to a mixed nationality group. This was fact-rich no-nonsense presentation. Uniquely, - I think - the tour took us in through the gladiators entrance to the arena. We walked through the walls and out on to the re-constructed arena floor as thousands of visitors looked down from the heights above. For a moment we had a glimpse of what it must have been like for those who strode out onto this surface to vanquish or perish 2000 years ago. It was a true highlight and the moment when we emerged blinking into the sunshine on the arena floor will stay with all of us. Jana, took us through the detail of how the gladiators and animals were brought up to the shows from the warren of subterranean passages beneath the arena floor. She brought it to life - the group were deeply engaged - save for a group of young women from the USA who seemed to trying to break the world-record for the number of vapid selfies taken inside a site where (according to Jana) up to a million people had lost their lives.

Immediately after the arena tour we were escorted to meet up with a second tour guide who was to take us through the Forum and the Palatine Hill. Lumi was waiting with an even larger group outside the Flavian amphitheatre (or Colosseum for the selfie-takers) and she took off at pace barking instructions to those who trailed behind. This tour was part-cabaret, part-history, part-contemporary political commentary and it was outstanding. She took our five year old son by the hand and using him as a "roman" prop of sorts led the group through a series of fascinating insights into the Roman world. She was both expert and enthusiast - a truly entertaining raconteur. An hour flew past.

If you can find these tour guides among the throngs of those hawking "tours" outside the Colosseum you are in for a treat. In a city where you have to be constantly on your guard for the tourist trap (28Euro for two cappuccinos and a bottle of water anyone?) this was genuinely value for money. Well done Jana and Lumi - your company should give you a pay rise. This was the highlight of our family trip to Rome.
